title: Wild's Advancements Recolored
description: Colours the advancements screen and tabs yellow and changes unobtained advancements to be blue.
body:
Tabs and container changed from grey to yellow. Matching the existing yellow for obtained advancements.
Unobtained advancements changed from grey to blue. Matching the existing blue for the unobtained title box.

![The Advancement frames and their boxes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b12697a83178f6ca0202cbb3295a70320024333.png)

The design choice is also partly used inside Wild's GUI if you want to check out a whole gui theme that is dark with green accents. [Over here for Wild's GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wilds-gui)

Any problems, suggestions or questions head over to my discord.
You will be a temporary member unless you give the thumbs up.
[Discord over here](https://discord.gg/NAd2jxWCDz)
